def transform(g):
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    rf=[2]*(n); rf[n//2]=1 if n%2 else 2
    cf=[2]*(m); cf[m//2]=1 if m%2 else 2
    out=[]
    for i,f in enumerate(rf):
        for _ in range(f):
            row=[]
            for j,fc in enumerate(cf):
                row += [g[i][j]]*fc
            out.append(row)
    return out
